definitions.raw: saved_after - raw_source_anchor, including any load conversion
definitions.adjusted: saved_after - BF16(raw_source_anchor); not a direct capture of training memory
definitions.unseen: Absent from every input_id in the first actual batch, including padding IDs; defense includes only outer roles 0/1 and excludes stopped inner role 2
definitions.basis: Saved native raw-displacement PC1/PC2. Uniform plane uses equal 0.5 weights; variance_plane weights by the first two eigenvalues normalized by their sum; variance_full divides by the full native spectrum sum. The latter describes only the contribution of the first two axes.
definitions.eigenvalues: Native eigenvalues sum squared displacements over selected snapshots without centering. Variance weighting here denotes this uncentered trajectory-energy weighting, not centered statistical variance.
definitions.concentration: 90% counts and top 10/100 fractions normalize within the named tensor and method; hidden columns are parameter coordinates
definitions.decoded_tokens: Only the top 20 rows per tensor/case by uniform-plane energy are decoded. Frequencies describe all recorded attack batches; target frequencies use shifted nonmasked labels.
definitions.interpretation: Algebraic agreement with a candidate BF16 loading map is measured, not assumed causal. Input embeddings and untied output head have different gradient support; output softmax can update classes absent from input IDs. No semantic biology-token inference is made.
